sourceContext.originPage: institutional / about page alternating image+text content sections

contentPattern.structure: two columns - illustration image beside a text block (paragraphs, optionally a check-list); image side alternates per section

suitableFor: side-by-side illustration and body copy layouts
text columns that may include a bulleted/check-list
notSuitableFor: grids of distinct repeatable items with uniform styling (use cards)
stacked vertical content where image sits below text (use default content)
